title: Nimbleness
summary: NIM'BLENESS, noun Lightness and agility in motion; quickness; celerity; speed; swiftness. It implies lightness and springiness. The stag thought it better to trust to the nimbleness of his feet. Ovid

inlines.v: NIM'BLENESS, noun Lightness and agility in motion; quickness; celerity; speed; swiftness. It implies lightness and springiness. The stag thought it better to trust to the nimbleness of his feet. Ovid ranged over Parnassus with great nimbleness and agility.
